boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten distinct University of Dayton library spaces for reading, conversation, and shared study without an admission or purchase requirement.

cards.title: Read together at Heidi's Porch
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, first floor
cards.notes: Bring a book or borrow one, then settle into this collaborative nook near the leisure-reading collection for a low-key catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor reading nook made for a quiet shared pause.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies Heidi's Porch as a welcoming, collaborative study nook near Roesch Library's leisure-reading collection; visitors may use library materials in the building.
cards.access_notes: Located in Roesch Library. Check current library hours before visiting; the university says visitors may use library materials in the building.

cards.title: Make a study-date plan at Gathering Place
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, second floor
cards.notes: Claim a table during open access, compare calendars or coursework, and keep the conversation moving in the flexible second-floor area.
cards.short_summary: A named active study area for a practical meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes Gathering Place as an open, flexible second-floor study area, and welcomes visitors to engage with its spaces and collections.
cards.access_notes: Typically configured as an active study area; it may be reserved for events. Use it only when available and during library hours.

cards.title: Take a conversation break at Roesch Retreat
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, fifth floor
cards.notes: Meet a friend for calm conversation or independent reading, then leave the space ready for the next person using the fifth floor.
cards.short_summary: A quieter fifth-floor destination for conversation or contemplation.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says Roesch Retreat on the fifth floor is a space for studying, conversation, or contemplation; its libraries invite visitors to engage with spaces and collections.
cards.access_notes: Fifth-floor space in Roesch Library. Respect the floor's considerate sound level and confirm current library access before going.

cards.title: Browse a book at Cameron Corner
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, fifth floor
cards.notes: Choose a title from the corner's leisure-reading collection and spend a screen-free stretch reading or discussing it with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A named reading nook with leisure books on the fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Cameron Corner as a fifth-floor leisure-reading space and describes it as a collection of books with a comfortable reading nook.
cards.source_title: Leisure Reading — University of Dayton Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the on-site collection during library hours. University Libraries states visitors may use library materials in the building.

cards.title: Pick a paperback from the leisure shelves
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, first-floor lobby
cards.notes: Browse the first-floor leisure titles together, pick a few covers to compare, and read on site without needing to buy a book.
cards.short_summary: Popular books and magazines in a named first-floor collection.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says Roesch Library's main leisure-reading collection is next to the first-floor lobby and that visitors may use library materials in the building.
cards.source_title: Leisure Reading — University of Dayton Libraries
cards.access_notes: On-site use needs no purchase; borrowing outside the building has separate eligibility rules. Check current Roesch Library hours.

cards.title: See the library gallery together
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, first floor
cards.notes: Walk through the named first-floor gallery, compare what catches your eye, and pair the visit with a library browse or study session.
cards.short_summary: A gallery stop inside Roesch Library's first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists the Stuart and Mimi Rose Gallery among Roesch Library's first-floor spaces and invites visitors to engage with its exhibits, spaces, and collections.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps — University of Dayton Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Roesch Library's first floor. No admission or purchase is listed; check library hours and any exhibit notices before visiting.

cards.title: Work through ideas in the Dialogue Zone
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the named first-floor zone for a collaborative work session, a club planning chat, or a shared review of class notes.
cards.short_summary: A distinct first-floor Roesch Library space for collaborative time.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Dialogue Zone as a first-floor Roesch Library space and says Roesch Library spaces are designed for working solo or with a group.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps — University of Dayton Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor. University Libraries invites visitors to engage with spaces; observe current access and noise guidance.

cards.title: Read among the Marian Library collections
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, seventh floor
cards.notes: Schedule ahead if you need specific material, then use the reading room for a focused visit and an unhurried conversation about what you find.
cards.short_summary: A seventh-floor reading room open to UD students and visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marian Library states that its reading room is open to UD students and visitors during regular hours, and visitors without a UD ID may use materials there.
cards.source_title: Research, Study, Borrow, Use — University of Dayton Marian Library
cards.access_notes: Open to students and visitors during regular Marian Library hours. Appointments are strongly encouraged for visitors seeking materials.

cards.title: Look through the Marian Library Gallery
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, seventh floor
cards.notes: Add a short gallery look-around to a seventh-floor library visit, then talk through the visual details that stood out to each person.
cards.short_summary: A named seventh-floor gallery within the Marian Library area.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries' floor map lists the Gallery among the seventh-floor Marian Library spaces, while the libraries invite visitors and community members to engage with exhibits and spaces.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps — University of Dayton Libraries
cards.access_notes: The Gallery is on Roesch Library's seventh floor near the Marian Library. No admission or purchase is listed; check current library access.

cards.title: Explore the Crèche Museum displays
cards.subtitle: Roesch Library, seventh floor
cards.notes: Visit the named museum space with a friend, take time to look closely at the displays, and keep the visit within library access hours.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive museum destination on Roesch Library's seventh floor.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries' floor map lists the Crèche Museum as a seventh-floor space, and its visitor information invites community members to engage with library exhibits and spaces.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps — University of Dayton Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the seventh floor in the Marian Library area. No admission or purchase is listed; confirm current library hours before visiting.
